cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you caption our holiday photo, what did I say when we missed that boat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember you laughing. Not the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll start you off: 'Well, that's the last time we trust...'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's try multiple choice. Your watch, my French, or the man selling us watches?

mechanism: A conducts an increasingly structured recall test before accepting a holiday caption, correcting vague memory into an exact quote through a cue and multiple choice.
confusable: D81 asks that the memory mattered; D83 tests remembered details even when B offers affectionate generality.
comparison: Tea alternative tests preferences without label aid; holiday alternative changes question format to recover an exact shared joke.
seedUse: Missed boat, laughing, quote fragment and watch/French choices derive from D83-b; S03 adds factual-caption and answer-format corrections.
